category: Bounded facade reconstruction; replacement of generic geometry, not a whole-complex reconstruction
scope: Mugar west block: identified south elevation from 7.2 m above the retained shared foundation to the retained 21.7 m roof datum.

sources.evidence: Section 4.3.4 describes the existing six-storey west Mugar block, plate-glass lower windows, narrow vertical upper windows, and deep thin concrete sun fins on south/east elevations. Figures 3-10/3-11 provide context for the retained building family and relative volumes, not proof of all completed 2014 details.
sources.use: Published BU planning reference; local study only, not a runtime texture.

sources.author: Pi.1415926535
sources.evidence: Exposed-aggregate concrete upper wall with deep narrow vertical apertures; broad continuous wall surfaces instead of a projecting rectilinear grid around each window. Deep lower sun-screen fins remain visually distinct.
sources.limits: Mature trees obscure much of the upper elevation. Exact upper bay count, aperture dimensions and all floor positions cannot be measured from this single photograph.
sources.use: Unmodified local architectural reference with attribution; no photograph pixels included in runtime materials.

sources.evidence: Looking north into the Link courtyard, the GSU wall on the left has a continuous brick area above tall lower glazing. Mugar is on the right. This supports only the identified east-facing GSU court wall, not repeating brick on every GSU orientation.
sources.limits: The photograph crops the uppermost GSU storey; that storey retains the previous model. Brick-band heights and lower window spacing are fitted estimates.
sources.use: BU-published reference for local study; not a claim of open licensing, runtime image use, or permission for third-party AI input.

generation.integration: src/features/world/bu-full-campus.ts::sertComplex, only the union and mugar branches
generation.approach: Source-backed procedural replacement with editable parameters; Three.js solid wall sections, recessed panes and frames share the existing campus batches.

mugar.southPlane: Derived from the retained mugar-west GIS-clipped footprint, using the same boundary as the existing lower screen module
mugar.columns: ceil(existing south width / 4.1 m), tied to the retained lower curtain-wall primary bay grid; not a surveyed upper window count
mugar.change: The selected upper face no longer emits the generic openings, projecting window sills/heads, storey bands, or full-height outer fins. Solid wall volumes partition around the replacement slit apertures. The 2026-10-25 lower screen remains in place.

gsu.selector: Only east-facing source facade segments centered in local x(-26.5,-22), z[74.5,98.2]
gsu.change: Replace the generic glazed middle storey with a solid brick wall and retain tall recessed lower lights. No old glazing or concrete grid is generated underneath this replacement. The top storey, other orientations, and original collision remain.

generation.coordinatePolicy: No footprint, building position, occupied mass, shared floor datum, sidewalk, entrance axis, road, passage, terrain or collision coordinate is moved.
generation.materials: Existing warm concrete/brick/frame palette and BU frontage glass are reused. Reflection remains the existing BU sky-based approximation; this work does not add live courtyard reflection or interiors.

qualityLevels.desktop: True slit apertures, retained masonry reveal depth and recessed solid frames.
qualityLevels.mobile: Same new aperture geometry and selected facade scope in the offline bake; complete gsu-mugar procedural assembly increases from 22,702 to 24,118 triangles, within the explicit 25,000 triangle test budget. Existing 15 visible material batches remain.

validation.technical: 23 tests passed and TypeScript typecheck passed. Ray tests confirm actual recess, flush masonry, GSU material separation, bounded facade orientation, unchanged footprint/height colliders and existing approach/passages.
validation.runtimeEvidence: Root integration records fixed-camera before/after views under output/bu-reality-20261026, including 01-gsu-street, 02-link-entry and 03-mugar-south.
validation.visualStatus: 已进行Mugar南侧固定机位前后和GSU庭院侧检查，并在完整游戏到访；修正后的墙/开口类别成立，整体材质和未覆盖立面仍为阶段状态。

remaining: Upper aperture counts and dimensions are photo-led estimates registered to the existing mass, not an as-built measured elevation.
Mugar north/east/west faces and stepped eastern blocks retain prior generic facade geometry; this bounded correction must not be described as the complete Mugar rebuild.
GSU uppermost storey and other elevations, current roof enclosures and some projecting volumes remain uncalibrated.
Trees, planting positions, interiors and furniture were not added or invented to conceal missing architectural evidence.
The building's exposed-aggregate concrete and glass still require further material/lighting comparison in the actual game.
